duplicate-fns-rule.desc: Verifies that there are no duplicate functions anywhere in the codebase. Free-functions and inherent `impl` methods are compared in the same pool, so a method duplicating a free-function is caught.
duplicate-fns-rule.equivalence: Two functions are duplicates when one can be turned into the other by renaming identifiers, one-for-one (a "p-match", or Type-2 clone). See the `duplicate-logic` rule description for the details; both rules share the same normalization.
duplicate-fns-rule.exemption: Methods in `impl Trait for Type` blocks, since the trait dictates their shape and the resulting boilerplate is unavoidable.
duplicate-fns-rule.config: - ignore: list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`). Naming any single member of a duplicate group exempts the whole group.
